name: mpdantic
description: Audits and repairs a music library for MPD: output buffer sizing by RAM, .mpdignore management, CUE sheet repair, playlist rebasing, tag validation. Rust core, thin Node shell.
author: Just a Nerd

volumio_info.details: Pedantic about your library, so MPD does not choke on it. Audits and repairs a music library for MPD, folder by folder, from its own management page.
volumio_info.changelog: 0.1.2 Third test cut: every surface in eleven languages; the findings of a check kept whole and worked through in a view of their own, with dismissals, an export as text and a re-check of folders; the tag editor and file names from tags or tags from file names by one pattern, in that view and on the Tags tab; Keep out on every folder row; QNAP's and Netatalk's folders known; every count in its singular.
